checks.name: No raw root-relative rendered links, asset attributes, HTTP form actions or endpoint attributes
Stylesheets have no root-relative URL dependencies
No independent PHP URL concatenation reads APP_URL outside the central service
Application logic contains no preview domain, workspace path or preview origin
The shared fetch wrapper resolves through the APP_URL client service
Client response redirects are validated centrally
Server Location headers are generated centrally
Front controller normalises the configured mount before dispatch
Authentication/CSRF cookie paths follow the configured mount
Queued notification links resolve at actual delivery time
public/.htaccess uses no host-dependent Options/php_value/RewriteBase directive
